label: rem:glossary-hom-set
title: Hom-set
html:
Hom-set. For objects X and Y in a category \mathbf{C}, the hom-set \mathrm{Hom}_{\mathbf{C}}(X, Y) is the collection of all morphisms from X to Y. We also write \mathbf{C}(X, Y) or X \to Y. In a locally small category, each hom-set is a genuine set.

When \mathbf{C} is R-linear, each hom-set carries the structure of an R-module. Composition is R-bilinear.

Mathlib reference. We denote the hom-set from X to Y by X ⟶ Y. Import: Mathlib.Combinatorics.Quiver.Basic (re-exported by Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Category.Basic). The type is Quiver.Hom X Y: CategoryTheory.Category extends CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct, which extends Quiver, whose Hom field carries the morphism types, and ⟶ is notation for Quiver.Hom.
